work.role: UX Designer to Lead UI/UX Designer
work.about: Finnish AAA studio behind Alan Wake and Control.

projects.title: Control Resonant
projects.summary: Joined late in production to fix problem interactions and get features to shipping quality: character customization, HUD notifications, upgrade trees and crafting.

projects.title: FBC: Firebreak
projects.summary: Led the full UI of a co-op multiplayer game from preproduction to post-launch: cut HUD overload, planned the build with UI programming, and put Remedy's first main menu inside a 3D world.

cover.alt: FBC: Firebreak main menu inside a 3D environment

projects.title: Alan Wake 2
projects.summary: Designed the maps, case board, inventory, weapon quick-select and photo mode for a narrative survival-horror game. Photo mode won Best Photo Mode at the Virtual Photography Awards 2024.

work.about: Robotic parcel lockers, warehouse to doorstep.

projects.title: Parcel locker platform
projects.summary: Designed across the whole parcel journey, built the team's first Figma component library, and redesigned back-office software that used to need a 40-page manual.

projects.title: Production analytics
projects.summary: Designed views that show managers what is holding production back, kept the shop-floor tablet app down to a few taps, and led the company rebrand.

approach.title: Too much on screen
approach.body: On FBC: Firebreak, every new feature asked for its own HUD feedback. I argued against what players didn't need and looked for ways to show the rest in the game world.

proof.label: FBC: Firebreak HUD
proof.note: Teammate visibility easy for 72% of players, up from 11%

proof.label: Alan Wake 2 case board
proof.note: Evidence players arrange by hand, inside the game world

approach.title: Hard to follow
approach.body: Players missed FBC's mission objectives, and Cleveron's office software came with a 40-page manual. Both got shorter text and a structure built around the task.

proof.label: FBC: Firebreak missions
proof.note: Objectives understood by 63% of players, up from 17%

proof.label: Cleveron office software
proof.note: Rebuilt around slot allocation and other daily tasks

approach.title: A lot of UI, a small team
approach.body: Two of us designed FBC's whole UI, and I planned the build with the UI programming lead around shared components. At Cleveron I set up the team's first component library.

proof.label: Cleveron component library
proof.note: Hundreds of components, built from scratch in Figma

freelance.intro: Branding and marketing for the Estonian music festivals Indiefest and Funkfest, plus digital painting and vector art from roughly eight years of art school.

body: I'm a designer based in Helsinki, Finland. My work has moved from manufacturing SaaS and robotic logistics to AAA game UI.
I work across UX, UI, interaction and visual design. I also animate and write front-end code, which helps me design things engineers can build.

I do my best work in-house, close to a product and the people building it, and I'm open to the right freelance collaboration. Outside work: playing and making video games, trading card games, museums, travel and cooking.
